hint.text:
The subjunctive form can be used in formal speech and writing. The subjunctive verb form is always the same, regardless of who it is referring to.

Informal: The Prime Minister demanded that all school dinners are free.

Formal: The Prime Minister demanded that all school dinners be free.
hint.sound: The subjunctive form can be used in formal speech and writing. The subjunctive verb form is always the same, regardless of who it is referring to. For example, informally you could say 'The Prime Minister demanded that all school dinners are free.' and formally you could say 'The Prime Minister demanded that all school dinners be free.'
